class MinCostFlow:
    def __init__(self):
        self.cur = [0] * (N + 1)
        self.vis = [False] * (N + 1)
        self.dis = [winf] * (N + 1)
        self.tag = [0] * (N + 1)

    def dij(self, s, t):
        for i in range(1, N + 1):
            self.dis[i] = winf
            self.cur[i] = 0
        self.dis[t] = 0
        q = []
        heapq.heappush(q, (0, t))
        while q:
            u = q[0][1]
            q.pop(0)
            if self.vis[u]:
                continue
            self.vis[u] = True
            for i in self.head[u]:
                v = self.r[i].to
                w = self.tag[u] + self.r[i ^ 1].w - self.tag[v]
                if self.r[i ^ 1].f and self.dis[u] + w < self.dis[v]:
                    self.dis[v] = self.dis[u] + w
                    heapq.heappush(q, (self.dis[v], v))
        for i in range(1, N + 1):
            self.tag[i] = min(self.tag[i] + self.dis[i], winf)
        if not self.vis[s]:
            return False
        for i in range(1, N + 1):
            self.vis[i] = False
        return True

    def dfs(self, u, t, fl):
        if u == t or not fl:
            return fl
        res = 0
        self.vis[u] = True
        for i in self.cur[u]:
            v = self.r[i].to
            if self.r[i].f and not self.vis[v] and self.tag[v] + self.r[i].w == self.tag[u]:
                f = self.dfs(v, t, min(fl, self.r[i].f))
                if f:
                    self.r[i].f -= f
                    self.r[i ^ 1].f += f
                    res += f
                    fl -= f
                    if not fl:
                        break
        self.vis[u] = False
        return res

    def work(self, s, t):
        while self.dij(s, t):
            w = self.dfs(s, t, inf)
            self.maxf += w
            self.minw += w * self.tag[s]
